<b>The Lost Fleas</b> is a [[Wayfarer Wishes|Wayfarer Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== How to Start ==
The Wish can be acquired either from [[Bone Bottom]]'s [[Wishwall]], or by talking directly to [[Fleamaster Mooshka]] in [[the Marrow]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Bone Bottom Wishwall.png!Location in Bone Bottom
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Flick the Fixer 02.png!Wishwall in Bone Bottom
}}

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Flea Caravan 01.png!Fleamaster Mooshka's location in the Marrow
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Flea Caravan 01.png!Fleamaster Mooshka in the Marrow
}}

== Wish ==
To complete the Wish, 5 [[Flea]]s must be rescued from across Pharloom. The special [[Huge Flea]] and NPC fleas [[Kratt]] and [[Vog]] count if they are rescued. After rescuing them, Hornet must talk to Fleamaster Mooshka, who is found at that time in [[the Marrow]].

{{For|a full list of Fleas|Flea#Locations}}

== Reward ==
[[File:Flea Brew.png|link=Flea Brew|left|thumb|100x100px]]

After completing the quest, Fleamaster Mooshka invites [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to travel with the Caravan to their next destination, that being [[Greymoor]]. If Hornet does not accept, they simply depart for that destination. If Hornet accepts, she is transported there with them. If they are travelling before [[Moorwing]] has been defeated, travelling with them allows temporarily skipping this boss.

Upon arriving in Greymoor, or after Hornet travels there on her own, Fleamaster Mooshka suggests talking to [[Grishkin]], who rewards her with the [[Flea Brew]].
